paragraphs: Rabbah of Parshunya. In Rav Pappa's time. Rava said, ‘Who is as wise as R' Hinena son of Rabbah of Parshunya?’ See there. It needs examination how Rabbah, his father, could be in the time of Rav Pappa, Rava's pupil. Rav Hamnuna son of Rava of Parshunya.
